name: backend_developer
description: Expert backend builder. Generates a complete, production-standard FastAPI backend (main.py, models, routes, database layer, requirements.txt) from a description of resources/entities. Applies real best practices (proper CRUD structure, Pydantic validation, async MongoDB via Motor, environment-based config) automatically, self-checks every generated file for syntax errors before saving, and saves the finished project into the user's sandbox workspace — ready to run, extend, or push to GitHub.

action.description: build: generate a full backend project. edit: change one part of an EXISTING file already in the sandbox (a prior build, or a file from a cloned repo) without regenerating everything around it. list_templates: show what resource shapes are supported.

project_name.description: Name of the backend project/API, e.g. 'Task Manager API'.

description.description: What the backend is for — used in generated docstrings and the README. More detail helps generated field names make sense.

resources.description: List of resources/entities to generate full CRUD endpoints for, e.g. [{'name': 'task', 'fields': [{'name': 'title', 'type': 'str'}, {'name': 'done', 'type': 'bool', 'default': false}]}]. If omitted, generates a single generic 'item' resource as a starting point.

auth_required.description: Whether to include a simple Bearer-token auth dependency stub on all routes. Defaults to false.

folder_name.description: Folder name to save the project under in the user's workspace. Defaults to a slugified version of project_name.

file_path.description: For edit: path to the existing file, relative to the workspace root — e.g. 'task-api/routes_task.py', or 'repos/owner__repo/main.py' for a file from a cloned GitHub repo.

old_str.description: For edit: the exact existing text to replace, copied verbatim from the file's real content (read it first if unsure) — must match exactly once in the file, or the edit is rejected rather than guessing which occurrence you meant.
